snippet.title: Defender of Darkness — Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Build your defenses before the battle begins — then support the army of darkness with spells as enemies advance along the lanes.

Divide your limited gold between towers, camps and each lord’s unique buildings. Once combat starts, you can no longer build. Camps send out fighters automatically, while gold earned in battle lets you summon mythics powerful enough to turn the tide.

• Slow enemies, deal damage and change the course of combat with spell cards.
• Unlock rescued lords’ unique cards and buy them with souls in the grimoire.
• Upgrade your squid pet between battles.

Your supply of spell cards is limited each battle. Will you use your strongest spell now or save it for the final waves?

Play Defender of Darkness on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4869280/Defender_of_Darkness/
